verified in CI by BusBench's own DO-178: description
The CAN decoder shall decode Intel and Motorola signals including signed and offset signals to physical units
The CAN decoder shall agree with an independent reference extraction for any signal geometry and refuse signals that do not fit the frame
The UDS client shall run session control / read / security access / write and surface every negative response code
ISO-TP reception shall reject a gap in the consecutive frame sequence number
ISO-TP shall round-trip every payload length and fail cleanly on arbitrary frames
The RTE shall report a signal as stale once its age exceeds the freshness limit
The overspeed warning shall latch above the limit and clear only when braking below it
A silent bus shall turn the warning lamp on (fail visible)
The application component shall depend on the RTE only
The windowed watchdog shall reject kicks that are too early or too late and an inverted window shall be a configuration error
A task that stops kicking shall be detected
A reading that is not physically reachable from the previous one shall be rejected
Faults shall be debounced and escalate to the most restrictive state and heal; a full fault table shall never read as NORMAL
The DoIP gateway shall answer any byte sequence with a well-formed message or nothing; bad version patterns and unknown payload types shall get a NACK
The DoIP gateway shall deliver diagnostics to the UDS ECU over ISO-TP
The Python tester and the C gateway shall interoperate over TCP; TCP framing shall survive split packets
Diagnostics shall be refused before routing activation and for any tester other than the activated one; vehicle identification shall work before activation
A header whose length field exceeds the received bytes shall be rejected
Words with even parity shall be discarded and the bit-reversed label shall be decoded correctly
Build and analyze shall round-trip for every width / label / signed value; unknown labels shall be refused
A word whose SSM is not Normal Operation shall be reported unusable
The Python and C ARINC 429 analyzers shall agree on the sample capture
1553 command words shall round-trip for all 65536 patterns with word count 32 encoded as 0 and mode codes preserved
The bus controller shall transfer data both ways and report absent / busy / faulty terminals as failures
A broadcast shall reach every terminal without a status word and one unresponsive terminal shall not stop the minor frame
Overlapping slices and slices past the major frame shall be rejected at configuration time
A hung partition shall not delay any other partition
Cross-partition memory access and access outside a slice shall be refused and logged
Every module shall be operable through the REST API
The API shall refuse non-local and non-JSON requests and report errors readably
Recorder frames shall round-trip through their byte form
A frame with any single bit flipped shall never be trusted; an empty slot is not a frame
The recorder shall record CAN and ARINC 429 traffic and replay it in time order
One corrupted frame shall cost exactly one frame and recording shall resume after the newest frame on power-up
The traceability tool shall parse requirements / JUnit results / source annotations and report every kind of gap
A fully traced project shall pass the gate and the report shall match the C implementation
